service.ur: کاروباری شخص کے لیے رہائشی ویزا

about: Get a visa to complete the 10-year Golden Residence process as an entrepreneur.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Project owners need a letter saying the project is innovative or future-oriented
Passport valid for at least 6 months
documents: Letter from the emirate's competent authority on the project's innovative nature
Accredited auditor's letter showing project value of at least 500,000 AED
channels: ICP Smart App or ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
